scope: Stable fixed-view visual regression claims where a versioned golden is an appropriate oracle
trigger: A candidate claims visual-regression success from screenshots or from a golden that the same producer created or updated for that candidate.
assertions: capturing and hashing a screenshot may verify VISUAL_EVIDENCE_CAPTURED but never implies a visual-regression oracle was applied
a visual-regression claim requires an immutable baseline identity, current image identity, comparison environment, metric, threshold, masks/styles, and result
a golden created or updated for the current candidate cannot be approved by that candidate's producer
a baseline update preserves the old and new identities, the old-vs-new diff, the reason, and an independent approval receipt
comparison evidence from an incompatible rendering environment is held rather than silently normalized
a diff beyond the frozen threshold yields VISUAL_REGRESSION_DETECTED
an independent human or user visual rejection overrides the stronger visual claim without erasing valid capture or technical-run evidence
state-roundtrip verification, visual-regression verification, manual visual acceptance, and user acceptance remain separate claims
